label: Vite+
hint: vp: dev, build, test, lint (Oxlint) and format (Oxfmt) in one toolchain

steering.content:
## Toolchain: Vite+

- `{{pmRun}} dev`: dev server (`vp dev`).
- `{{pmRun}} build`: production build (`vp build`).
- `{{pmRun}} lint`: Oxlint with type-aware rules and type checking (`vp lint`).
- `{{pmRun}} test`: Vitest, once (`vp test run`); `vp test watch` for watch mode.
- `{{pmRun}} format`: Oxfmt (`vp fmt`).
- There is no ESLint or Prettier: lint and format settings live in the `lint` / `fmt` blocks of `vite.config.ts`.
- `vite` and `vitest` are pinned to the Vite+ versions through package-manager overrides; don't add or upgrade them separately.

## Library build (Vite+)

- `{{pmRun}} build`: `vp pack` (tsdown) → `dist/index.js` (ESM) + `dist/index.d.ts`, configured in the `pack` block of `vite.config.ts`. `dependencies` and `peerDependencies` stay external.
- There is no dev server for the library itself; develop components in Storybook.
